title: Pondering Pebblefin
statement: A thumb-sized, opalescent goby with lantern-blue freckles, the Pebblefin drifts through pale green water and rearranges tiny stones into constellations, then studies them with grave, unearned satisfaction. Its tank holds one arch of moon-white coral, a curtain of softly swaying hairgrass, and a single silver bubble that it follows everywhere but never seems to catch.
